variables.definition: net income or signed net loss
variables.context: Same reporting entity, period, accounting basis and currency

assumptions: Other income is disjoint from revenue; all recognized expenses and losses, including tax, are included exactly once.
All amounts cover the same entity, accounting basis and reporting period.
limitations: Net income under accrual accounting is not necessarily net cash flow.
This is a broad income-statement identity; the existing pretax-income-minus-tax equation is a different decomposition.
